response.overview: For Ludington State Park 2023, filmmaker Paul Belloni shot on Super 8 film that expired in 1980, using a camera made in the late 1960s. He even developed the film himself, using pine needles, cones, bark, acorns and leaves he collected from the forest floor — plus some vitamin C and washing soda. The result is a strange, beautiful three-minute experimental film.
response.title: Ludington State Park 2023
